_comment.hero: home.hero.* keys are injected into raw HTML: markup is allowed, escape < > & by hand.
common.disclaimer: EcoMed AI helps you keep track of the medicines you already have at home. It does not diagnose, does not prescribe treatment and does not replace advice from a doctor or pharmacist.
sidebar.prices.title: 💊 Pharmacy prices in your city
sidebar.prices.demo_note: Demo data. Check the current price with the pharmacy.
match.a: You already have this exact package at home.
match.b: Your home cabinet contains a medicine with the same active ingredient, strength and form. This does not mean the medicines may be substituted on your own.
match.c: The active ingredient matches, but the strength, form or composition differs. Check the package and ask a doctor or pharmacist.
match.none: No such medicine found at home.
home.hero.title: A home medicine cabinet with no wasted purchases and no expired medicines
home.hero.sub: Scan packages, spot duplicates, keep an eye on expiry dates and learn how to dispose of medicines safely.

add.title: ➕ Add a medicine
add.mode.label: How would you like to add it?
add.manual_hint: Fill in the fields by hand — no photo needed. Required fields are marked with an asterisk.
add.photo_hint: Photograph the package and the fields will be filled in automatically. Every field can be corrected before saving. Fields that cannot be read are left empty rather than guessed.
add.warn.no_vision: The vision provider is not configured (OPENAI_API_KEY is missing). Switch to manual entry.
add.camera: Take a photo of the package
add.consent: I agree to send the photo to an external AI provider for recognition.
add.error.ocr: Recognition is unavailable — please fill in the form manually below.
add.field.inns_help: For example: paracetamol. For combination medicines, separate with commas.
add.error.required: Please fill in the required fields: name, active ingredient and quantity.
add.saved: Saved (id={id}). Check for possible duplicates in the “{section}” section.
pc.title: 🛒 Check before buying
pc.subtitle: Check whether you already have the medicine at home before buying it. The result is information about your stock, not permission to substitute.
pc.catalog.label: Pick from the catalogue or enter manually
pc.field.name: Name
pc.not_found: No such medicine at home — the purchase may well be justified.
pc.avoided: 🚫 Didn't buy it — already at home
pc.avoided_ok: Recorded as a confirmed avoided purchase.

disposal.title: ♻️ Safe disposal
disposal.disclaimer: Only rules from an approved set of sources are shown. Where the rules for households are not clearly defined, the app does not invent a procedure.
disposal.no_point: There is no confirmed collection point for the selected city in our database. Do not rely on an unverified address; ask your pharmacy or the local competent authority about the procedure.
disposal.points.title: Collection points — {city}
disposal.badge.demo: 🟡 demo entry — do not use as a working address
disposal.not_accepted: ⛔ Confirmed points do NOT accept: syringes, needles, infusion sets or blood-contaminated waste.
disposal.no_verified: There are no confirmed points in this city. Unverified locations are not presented as working ones.
disposal.map_note: The map shows points with known coordinates (approximate). The map does not prove that a point accepts medicines; rely on the address.
disposal.record.title: Record a hand-in
disposal.record.ok: Recorded as a confirmed environmental action.
family.title: 👪 Household
family.subtitle: Access to records is limited by household identifier and role. A member only sees their own household.
family.demo.title: Demo household
family.invite.title: Invite a member
family.invite.note: Invitation links are single-use or time-limited. Invitations are disabled in the demo.
family.roles.title: Roles and permissions
family.role.owner.rights: Create the household, invite members, full access to records, reports
family.role.editor.rights: Add and update, record purchases and disposals
family.role.editor.limits: Cannot manage the owner or the settings
family.role.dataadmin.limits: No access to personal stock without cause

treatment.title: ⏰ Medication intake
treatment.disclaimer: The app does not prescribe treatment and does not choose doses. Enter the schedule exactly as your doctor prescribed it — the app will remind you and update the stock in your cabinet.
treatment.reminder.note: Reminders appear when you open the app: there are no background notifications or push messages here.
treatment.due.title: Due now
treatment.due.empty: No scheduled intakes for the near future.
treatment.due.no_stock: Not enough left in the cabinet — the intake will be recorded, but there is nothing to deduct.
treatment.confirmed_no_stock: The intake was recorded, but the cabinet stock is unchanged — there was nothing to deduct. Please check the quantity in your cabinet.
treatment.skipped: Marked as a skipped intake. Stock unchanged.
treatment.already: This intake has already been recorded.
treatment.manual.title: Record an intake without a prescription
treatment.manual.hint: If a medicine was taken outside a schedule, record it here so the cabinet stock stays correct.
treatment.manual.name: Medicine name
treatment.courses.title: Treatment schedules
treatment.courses.stock_short: ⚠️ Stock will not last to the end of the course — restock in advance.
treatment.courses.stock_none: Not linked to the cabinet — stock is not deducted.

treatment.form.name: Medicine name *
treatment.form.saved: Schedule saved. Reminders will appear in the “{section}” section.
treatment.form.error: Check the schedule fields: a name, a dose above zero and at least one time of day are required.
